title: I SEEK redemption from our Christ

lines.text: I SEEK redemption from our Christ
For swamp is much upon my ways
Hence by water or by fire
Just wash me clean.
Just wash me clean, in soul in flesh
I mind not fire if so is best
I shall be pleased by any means
To clear all sins from all my ways.
If Thou bless me to see visions
I shall be thankful on to Thee
But pure and holy heart I need
Give Thou me Lord.
For when my heart is clean and pure
Pure and true visions will I see
For now has darkness cover all
Honest Vision.
I try to walk on righteous road
And go away from sinful thoughts
Though I struggle ever on this
Yet am filthy.
Amen.
